name: Southxchange

limitations.detail: Corpus only states private endpoints require API access+secret keys; Key/Sign headers with HMAC-SHA512 over JSON body taken from official SouthXChange API v4 docs, not the provided corpus
Candle 'Date' is ISO datetime (UTC); history start/end params are unix SECONDS, not ms; periods capped at 500 (larger silently reset)
(end_ts - start_ts) / periods must equal an allowed granularity (MarketHistoryIntervals constants, in seconds) or unexpected data returned; full allowed-interval list not enumerated in corpus
Markets returned as array of arrays [listingCurrency, referenceCurrency, pricePrecision]; third element is price decimal precision, not qty step
{symbol} expands to two path segments LISTING/REFERENCE (e.g. /book/ETH/BTC); single-market price available at /price/{symbol}

Only buy/sell orders via POST /{listing}/{reference}/buy|sell with amount and optional limit_price (market order if price omitted); no stop/advanced types documented; order endpoints not expressible in template
Fees vary per market (example ETH/BTC: maker 0.001=0.1%, taker 0.003=0.3%); fee_pct=0.3 uses example taker fee; query fees endpoint for per-market values
min_order_usdt: MinOrderListingCurrency reported as None in docs â no minimum order documented, set 0
qty_step not documented â using conservative default 8
price_band_pct not documented â no local price band check (0)
Rate limits not documented â using conservative default min_gap_sec 1.0
No margin/futures trading API documented â margin null; collateral/leverage/interest rule defaults unused
Only BTC reference currency observed in docs; full quote list should be confirmed via /markets
Provided corpus (GitHub/PyPI pages) contains no endpoint specs; paths/params sourced from SouthXchange public API conventions and must be verified at runtime
Corpus only shows API key+secret usage (go-southxchange); HMAC-SHA512 signature over path+params with Key/Sign headers taken from community libraries, not stated in official docs
No OHLCV kline endpoint documented; /api/index-levels returns historical price levels whose exact fields and timestamp units are undocumented - candles must be synthesized
Exact JSON field names of prices/book/market responses not documented in corpus; field_map values are best-effort
Order placement/cancel/trading endpoints not described in provided corpus
fee_pct/min_order_usdt/qty_step/price_band_pct/rate limit not documented - using conservative defaults
Supported quote currencies not enumerated in corpus; USD/BTC/LTC/ETH from exchange conventions
tf/period semantics for index-levels undocumented - interval mapping is best-effort
